name: ChainSwap receive() unbound signatory check

classification.summary: The bridge's receive() recovered a signer with ecrecover but never required it to equal the caller-supplied signatures[i].signatory, so any garbage signature passed the quota/duplicate checks and released bridged tokens.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: 2021-05-04T20:09:27Z (block 12369818, tx 0x2c3d078fcaea7ffe95abd2869ceac68db1b525c5278082d14f88d315ea6d2595): ProxyFactory 0xbf515ff38d55737c56d62e8b6a8eea322ec38aa5 productImplementations('TokenMapped') changed from 0x3c894caf21f18f42d8d06daf26983c4b6a32fc1c to 0xec2c74c9e2457d328bc6216858280ea13e740e8a, the implementation the proxy executed at the incident

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/chainswap.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

sources.note: onchain review: bridge proxy 0x7fe68FC06e1A870DcbeE0acAe8720396DC12FC86 created 2021-03-13T23:07:57Z by 0xc96ecc8456cd0e5b20c1c40989adad9c1809da9c, unrelated to the attack sender 0x941a9e3b...; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident, age measured from deployment.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CORRECTION, by the same method already recorded for this file's BSC row. The victim is a ChainSwap InitializableProductProxy: its EIP-1967 implementation slot is empty and the delegate target is resolved as IProxyFactory(factory).productImplementations(name), with FACTORY_SLOT 0x7a45a402e4cb6e08ebc196f20f66d5d30e67285a2a8aa80503fa409e727a4af1 = 0xbf515ff38d55737c56d62e8b6a8eea322ec38aa5 and NAME_SLOT 0x4cd9b827ca535ceb0880425d70eff88561ecdf04dc32fcf7ff3b15c587f8a870 = 'TokenMapped', both constant over [12033100, 12751488] (25-point probe each). Binary-searching eth_call of productImplementations('TokenMapped') over the same range: 0x3c894caf21f18f42d8d06daf26983c4b6a32fc1c at creation, changed to 0xec2c74c9e2457d328bc6216858280ea13e740e8a at block 12369818 (2021-05-04T20:09:27Z) by tx 0x2c3d078fcaea7ffe95abd2869ceac68db1b525c5278082d14f88d315ea6d2595 from the deployer 0xc96ecc8456cd0e5b20c1c40989adad9c1809da9c, then constant to the incident (51-point dense re-probe). callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the proxy delegatecalled only 0xec2c74c9e2457d328bc6216858280ea13e740e8a, which has zero DELEGATECALL opcodes. Age 1625272990 - 1620158967 = 5,114,023 s (59.2 d), was 9,596,113 s (111.1 d) from deployment.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/chainswap.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
